mapper.select: select id, user_id, gender, birthday, height_cm, weight_kg, activity_level, health_goal, bmr, tdee, target_calorie, target_protein, target_fat, target_carb, create_time, update_time from health_profile where user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: insert into health_profile (user_id, gender, birthday, height_cm, weight_kg, activity_level, health_goal, bmr, tdee, target_calorie, target_protein, target_fat, target_carb, create_time, update_time) values (#{userId}, #{gender}, #{birthday}, #{heightCm}, #{weightKg}, #{activityLevel}, #{healthGoal}, #{bmr}, #{tdee}, #{targetCalorie}, #{targetProtein}, #{targetFat}, #{targetCarb}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}) on duplicate key update gender = #{gender}, birthday = #{birthday}, height_cm = #{heightCm}, weight_kg = #{weightKg}, activity_level = #{activityLevel}, health_goal = #{healthGoal}, bmr = #{bmr}, tdee = #{tdee}, target_calorie = #{targetCalorie}, target_protein = #{targetProtein}, target_fat = #{targetFat}, target_carb = #{targetCarb}, update_time = #{updateTime}
